python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

for row in root.findall('.//m:sheetData/m:row', ns):
    r = row.get('r')
    cells = []
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        ref = c.get('r'); t = c.get('t'); v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        f = c.find('m:f', ns)
        val = ''
        if t == 'inlineStr':
            is_el = c.find('m:is', ns)
            val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_el.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')) if is_el is not None else ''
        elif v is not None:
            val = v.text
        formula = f.text if f is not None else ''
        cells.append(f'{ref}={val!r}' + (f' [formula: {formula}]' if formula else ''))
    print(f'Row {r}: ' + ' | '.join(cells))
"
